There are 2 free seats still available in the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective [SQL]. 

Here are the details for the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective:

| Course Code | Title | Capacity | Seats Taken | Free Seats |

| CS3E1 | Machine Learning [SQL] | 15 [SQL] | 13 [SQL] | 2 [SQL] |
sql: SELECT t1.course_code, t1.title, t1.capacity, COUNT(t2.enrollment_id) AS seats_taken, (t1.capacity - COUNT(t2.enrollment_id)) AS free_seats FROM courses AS t1 LEFT JOIN enrollments AS t2 ON t1.course_id = t2.course_id AND t2.status = 'enrolled' WHERE t1.course_code = 'CS3E1' GROUP BY t1.course_code, t1.title, t1.capacity LIMIT 200
